weaknesses.point: The model relies on kinetic rate hierarchies to enforce directionality rather than explicitly incorporating the free energy drop of ATP hydrolysis into the energy landscape, leaving the thermodynamic driving force of the non-equilibrium steady state unclear.

The assumption of perfectly rigid bars and hinges without elastic bias ignores the entropic and energetic costs of constraining molecular linkers in real synthetic systems, which may disrupt the proposed negative allosteric coupling.

While the system is described as an ATPase-like machine, the simulations track chemical turnover and state occupancy but do not quantify mechanical work performed against an external load, limiting the assessment of its function as a motor.

The avoidance of futile cycles depends critically on specific rate constraints (e.g., cleavage slower than ligand dissociation), yet a comprehensive sensitivity analysis demonstrating the robustness of the cycle to variations in binding energies and reaction rates is lacking.

The reaction network involves hundreds of microstates described primarily in the Supplement, making the core mechanism difficult to follow in the main text; a simplified summary of the dominant pathways would improve accessibility.
